acceptance: t3:docker pulls its images without hitting the anonymous rate limit (authenticated or mirrored), shown by a passing dispatched run.
The codespell job no longer builds a Docker Hub container, or pulls it authenticated.
context:
Found in the 2026-10-09 tracker review. Blocks dlv2-22-nightly-t3-shadow green runs.

Decision (owner, 2026-10-09): no Docker Hub secret. Official images use public.ecr.aws/docker/library; vendor images use a verified non-Docker-Hub vendor registry, otherwise a pinned GHCR mirror workflow with GITHUB_TOKEN packages:write. Preserve pinned digests. Replace the codespell Docker action with uv installation. Native implementation is in fix/ci-registry-pulls; one combined nightly-v2 run_drift=true verification dispatch follows merged Docker/drift/perf fixes. Parent owns tracker; no external agents used.

Checkpoint 2026-10-10: PR #2888 remains open at cccec335475cc35bc2f2c1c828989e47d009af5e, base develop@80874df43806c8d57ca2c03a15a0ce5e8fbebd4b; auto-merge disabled. Current CI run 38078777975 succeeded on that exact head. Exact-head Oracle verdict run 38078775770 completed with SHIP_WITH_FIXES and three findings: (1) tag mirror existence checks do not compare upstream digest; (2) ClickHouse/Trino GHCR overrides are not checked against Compose defaults in nightly-v2 and docker-integration; (3) mirror-cedardb is a hard need of a combined DuckDB/CedarDB throughput job, so mirror failure skips unrelated DuckDB evidence. These findings are confirmed.

Remediation authorized by the user's request to complete the handoff: compare source and GHCR digests on every mirror run and fail visibly on drift; add a focused behavioral mirror test and a parity contract covering both image consumers; split DuckDB and CedarDB throughput into independent jobs, with the commit status still reflecting either job's failure. Native-only subagents completed bounded read-only analysis; no external harness was used. After changes, rerun proving tests and PR gates, then exact-head Oracle. Keep the item open until the passing dispatched Docker verification and the codespell acceptance are demonstrated.
description:
Docker Hub refuses unauthenticated pulls with "429 Too Many Requests" / "toomanyrequests". This failed all three nightly-v2 t3:docker jobs (postgres, trino, clickhouse) in dispatch 37991400931, and the codespell job in Documentation runs 37991354788 and 37994012169 (the codespell-project/actions-codespell container build). The codespell job is continue-on-error, but t3:docker failures block a green nightly-v2.

Use authenticated pulls (a read-only Docker Hub token), a registry mirror such as ghcr.io copies of the images, or for codespell an install through uv instead of the Docker action.
